images.title: Five quarters of three halves
images.purpose: Show 3/2 as one and a half squares and one quarter of it as 3/8.
images.composition: Two unit squares side by side centred horizontally, caption lines below, white space around.
exact_structure: Two unit squares of equal size side by side, each split into 2 rows and 4 columns: 8 cells each.
Left square: all 8 cells filled light teal #0072B2. Right square: only the top row (4 cells) filled light teal #0072B2; bottom row white. Together 12 teal cells: 3/2.
Reddish purple #CC79A7 fills the first column of the left square (2 cells) and the top cell of the first column of the right square (1 cell): 3 purple cells in all.
images.takeaway: One quarter of 3/2 is 3/8, and five of those make 15/8.
images.description: Two unit squares cut into 2 rows and 4 columns, with 12 teal cells and 3 of them purple.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Count the 3 purple cells out of 8 cells in a whole square.

image_decisions.why: Showing 3/2 as a square and a half makes the quarter easy to find.
